blocks.zh: Date Information 日期資訊
blocks.en: Date Information

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 — 有效期限符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.2.1 — Use-by Date Symbol: Commentary

blocks.zh: 符號含義
blocks.en: Meaning of the symbol

blocks.zh: 有效期限（Use By / Expiry Date）是醫療器械標籤上最關鍵的符號之一。沙漏加叉號圖形，直觀表達「時間已到，勿再使用」的概念。
blocks.en: The use-by date (Use By / Expiry Date) is one of the most critical symbols on a medical device label. The hourglass with a cross conveys intuitively that "time is up; do not use any more".

blocks.zh: 此符號源自 ISO 7000-1051，是全球公認的到期日標識方式，無需文字即可跨語言溝通。
blocks.en: This symbol derives from ISO 7000-1051 and is the globally recognized way of indicating an expiry date; it communicates across languages without any text.

blocks.zh: 製藥包材實際應用
blocks.en: Practical applications for pharmaceutical packaging

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑（Sterile Injectables）：玻璃瓶或安瓿上必須標示有效期，通常格式為 YYYY-MM
blocks.en: Sterile injectables: the glass vial or ampoule must carry an expiry date, usually in YYYY-MM format

blocks.zh: 預充式注射器（PFS）：滅菌包裝袋外層亦需標示有效期，連同滅菌確認標誌
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes (PFS): the outer layer of the sterile packaging pouch must also carry the expiry date, together with the sterilization mark

blocks.zh: 一次性滅菌器材（Single-use devices）：手術包、導管等均需此符號
blocks.en: Single-use sterile devices: surgical packs, catheters and the like all need this symbol

blocks.zh: 藥物輸送裝置（Drug Delivery Devices）：包括自動注射筆、吸入器
blocks.en: Drug delivery devices: including auto-injector pens and inhalers

blocks.zh: 生活類比
blocks.en: Everyday analogy

blocks.zh: 就像牛奶盒上的「最佳飲用日期」，醫療器械的有效期限符號告訴使用者：超過這個日期，製造商不再保證產品的安全性與功能性。
blocks.en: Like the "best before" date on a milk carton, the use-by symbol on a medical device tells the user that beyond this date the manufacturer no longer guarantees the safety and functionality of the product.

blocks.zh: 對於無菌產品，此日期更是屏障完整性（sterility barrier integrity）的保證期限，而非只是外觀或功能的參考。
blocks.en: For sterile products, this date is also the guaranteed period of sterility barrier integrity, not merely a reference for appearance or function.

blocks.zh: Annex 1 連結
blocks.en: Link to Annex 1

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022年修訂版）第8.120條要求無菌產品的最終容器及外包裝均需標示完整可追溯資訊，包含有效期限。ISO 15223-1的沙漏符號是符合此要求的國際標準方式。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision), 8.120, requires the final container and outer packaging of sterile products to carry complete traceable information, including the expiry date. The hourglass symbol of ISO 15223-1 is the international standard way of meeting this requirement.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 — 製造日期符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.2.2 — Date of Manufacture Symbol: Commentary

blocks.zh: 製造日期（Date of Manufacture）符號為工廠建築圖形，代表該醫療器械的實際生產日期。這是用於可追溯性（traceability）而非安全限制的符號。
blocks.en: The date of manufacture (Date of Manufacture) symbol is a factory building pictogram and represents the actual production date of the medical device. It is used for traceability, not as a safety limit.

blocks.zh: 批次追溯：製造日期與批號（Lot/Batch Number）配合，確保完整的生產記錄可追溯
blocks.en: Batch traceability: the date of manufacture, together with the lot/batch number, ensures that complete production records can be traced

blocks.zh: 穩定性計算：ICH Q1A要求穩定性研究從製造日期起算，標籤上的製造日期是關鍵起點
blocks.en: Stability calculation: ICH Q1A requires stability studies to be counted from the date of manufacture, so the date of manufacture on the label is the key starting point

blocks.zh: 召回管理：若某批次出現品質問題，製造日期有助於界定受影響批次範圍
blocks.en: Recall management: if a batch has a quality problem, the date of manufacture helps define the range of affected batches

blocks.zh: 冷鏈管理：冷凍乾燥製劑等需要在製造後特定時間內完成轉售，製造日期是計算依據
blocks.en: Cold chain management: products such as freeze-dried formulations must be resold within a specific period after manufacture, and the date of manufacture is the basis for calculating it

blocks.zh: 製造日期 vs. 有效期限：關係說明
blocks.en: Date of manufacture vs. use-by date: how they relate

blocks.zh: 有效期限 = 製造日期 + 核准保存期限（shelf life per stability study）
blocks.en: Use-by date = date of manufacture + approved shelf life (shelf life per stability study)

blocks.zh: 兩者都需標示時，工廠符號（製造日期）在前，沙漏符號（有效期限）在後
blocks.en: When both are shown, the factory symbol (date of manufacture) comes first and the hourglass symbol (use-by date) second

blocks.zh: 若標示位置有限，優先保留有效期限（更直接關係使用安全）
blocks.en: If space for marking is limited, give priority to the use-by date (it bears more directly on safe use)

blocks.zh: 與 FDA 21 CFR Part 211 的連結
blocks.en: Link to FDA 21 CFR Part 211

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR §211.68 及 §211.130 均要求標籤包含足夠資訊以確保可追溯性。製造日期是藥品標籤的法定要素，ISO 15223-1的工廠符號提供了標準化的視覺表達方式。
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 211.68 and 211.130 both require the label to carry enough information to ensure traceability. The date of manufacture is a legally required element of a drug label, and the factory symbol of ISO 15223-1 provides a standardized visual expression for it.

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 — 勿在此日期後使用 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.2.3 — Do Not Use After This Date: Commentary

blocks.zh: 「Do Not Use After」（勿在此日期後使用）與有效期限在本質上相同，但語氣更為強制。它以禁止指令而非建議的方式表達期限限制。
blocks.en: "Do Not Use After" is essentially the same as the use-by date, but the tone is more mandatory. It expresses the time limit as a prohibition rather than a recommendation.

blocks.zh: 語意差異比喻
blocks.en: An analogy for the difference in meaning

blocks.zh: Use By：就像食品標籤上的「最佳賞味期限」，是廠商對品質的保證。
blocks.en: Use By: like the "best before" date on a food label, a manufacturer's assurance of quality.

blocks.zh: Do Not Use After：更接近「此後禁止食用」的法規要求，不允許任何彈性解讀，風險由使用者自負的情況不被接受。
blocks.en: Do Not Use After: closer to a regulatory requirement of "do not consume after this date"; it leaves no room for flexible interpretation, and use at the user's own risk is not accepted.

blocks.zh: 在無菌醫療器械（尤其是植入性裝置、血管導管等高風險類別）中，應優先使用§ 5.2.3的禁止性表達。
blocks.en: For sterile medical devices (especially high-risk categories such as implantable devices and vascular catheters), the prohibitive expression of 5.2.3 should be preferred.

blocks.zh: 製藥包材應用情境
blocks.en: Application scenarios in pharmaceutical packaging

blocks.zh: Class III 植入性裝置（如人工心臟瓣膜、脊椎融合系統）：幾乎強制要求禁止性日期標示
blocks.en: Class III implantable devices (such as prosthetic heart valves and spinal fusion systems): a prohibitive date marking is almost mandatory

blocks.zh: 體外診斷試劑（IVD）：試劑效期直接影響診斷準確性，使用禁止性語言更安全
blocks.en: In vitro diagnostic reagents (IVD): reagent shelf life directly affects diagnostic accuracy, so prohibitive wording is safer

blocks.zh: 滅菌包裝組件：過期後滅菌屏障可能已降解，必須禁止使用
blocks.en: Sterilized packaging components: after expiry the sterility barrier may have degraded, so use must be prohibited

blocks.zh: 實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical reminder

blocks.zh: 在台灣，依據醫療器材管理法及相關標籤規範，輸入醫療器材須以中文或英文標示有效期限，§ 5.2.3的圖文並用方式（符號＋日期數字）是最被廣泛接受的格式。TFDA審查標籤時，ISO 15223-1符號的使用可作為符合性聲明的技術依據。
blocks.en: In Taiwan, under the Medical Devices Act and the related labelling rules, imported medical devices must show the expiry date in Chinese or English, and the combined symbol-and-text approach of 5.2.3 (symbol + numeric date) is the most widely accepted format. When TFDA reviews labels, the use of ISO 15223-1 symbols can serve as the technical basis for a declaration of conformity.

blocks.zh: Sterility and Sterilization 無菌性與滅菌
blocks.en: Sterility and Sterilization

blocks.zh: 5.3.1 — 無菌（STERILE）符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.3.1 — STERILE Symbol: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念
blocks.en: Core concept

blocks.zh: STERILE 符號是醫療器械包裝上最重要的聲明之一，代表產品已通過驗證的滅菌製程，達到無菌保證水準（SAL = 10⁻⁶），即每百萬個產品中存活微生物的機率不超過1個。
blocks.en: The STERILE symbol is one of the most important claims on medical device packaging. It indicates that the product has undergone a validated sterilization process and achieved a sterility assurance level (SAL = 10⁻⁶), that is, a probability of no more than one surviving microorganism per million products.

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 應用場景
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical CDMO application scenarios

blocks.zh: 無菌充填灌裝（Aseptic Fill-Finish）：最終容器（小瓶、安瓿、預充式注射器）上的 STERILE 聲明需有完整的工藝驗證支撐
blocks.en: Aseptic fill-finish: the STERILE claim on the final container (vial, ampoule, prefilled syringe) must be supported by complete process validation

blocks.zh: 滅菌包裝組件（Sterilized Components）：針對橡膠塞、鋁蓋、玻璃瓶的預滅菌供貨，組件本身的 STERILE 標示需有供應商的滅菌驗證記錄
blocks.en: Sterilized components: for pre-sterilized supply of rubber stoppers, aluminium caps and glass vials, the STERILE marking on the component itself must be backed by the supplier's sterilization validation records

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌產品（Terminal Sterilization）：最終滅菌製劑同樣使用此符號，但需配合 §5.3.3–5.3.5 的滅菌方式後綴
blocks.en: Terminally sterilized products: terminally sterilized preparations use the same symbol, but it must be combined with the sterilization-method suffix of 5.3.3–5.3.5

blocks.zh: 無菌保證水準（SAL）說明
blocks.en: Explanation of the sterility assurance level (SAL)

blocks.zh: SAL 10⁻⁶：每百萬個產品中，存活一個微生物的概率為 0.000001
blocks.en: SAL 10⁻⁶: the probability of one surviving microorganism per million products is 0.000001

blocks.zh: 這不代表「零微生物」，而是一個統計概念
blocks.en: This does not mean "zero microorganisms"; it is a statistical concept

blocks.zh: ISO 11135（EO滅菌）、ISO 11137（輻射滅菌）、ISO 17665（蒸氣滅菌）均以此作為驗收標準
blocks.en: ISO 11135 (EO sterilization), ISO 11137 (radiation sterilization) and ISO 17665 (steam sterilization) all use this as the acceptance criterion

blocks.zh: 滅菌過度殺滅法（Overkill Method）：D值 × cycles 達到 SAL 10⁻⁶ 以上的設計
blocks.en: Overkill method: a design in which D-value × cycles reaches SAL 10⁻⁶ or better

blocks.zh: Annex 1 連結（EU GMP 2022）
blocks.en: Link to Annex 1 (EU GMP 2022)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022）第1章明確要求滅菌製劑的標籤必須呈現適當的無菌狀態宣告。STERILE 符號配合適當滅菌方式標示，是符合 Annex 1 §4.34 標籤完整性要求的核心元素。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), Chapter 1, expressly requires the labels of sterile preparations to carry an appropriate declaration of sterile status. The STERILE symbol, combined with the appropriate sterilization-method marking, is a core element in meeting the label integrity requirement of Annex 1, 4.34.

blocks.zh: 5.3.2 — 非無菌（NON-STERILE）符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.3.2 — NON-STERILE Symbol: Commentary

blocks.zh: NON-STERILE 明確告知使用者：此產品尚未滅菌，使用前需由終端使用者自行滅菌，或本產品設計上不需要無菌條件。
blocks.en: NON-STERILE tells the user plainly that the product has not been sterilized and must be sterilized by the end user before use, or that the product by design does not need sterile conditions.

blocks.zh: 應用場景
blocks.en: Application scenarios

blocks.zh: 可重複滅菌手術器械（如鑷子、手術剪）：出廠時為非無菌，由醫療機構自行滅菌
blocks.en: Reusable surgical instruments (such as forceps and surgical scissors): supplied non-sterile and sterilized by the healthcare facility itself

blocks.zh: 植入前組件（如骨科植入物半成品）：出廠非無菌，待最終組裝後再行滅菌
blocks.en: Pre-implant components (such as semi-finished orthopaedic implants): supplied non-sterile and sterilized after final assembly

blocks.zh: 研究用器材：實驗室環境不需要滅菌條件的診斷裝置
blocks.en: Research-use devices: diagnostic devices used in a laboratory environment that does not require sterile conditions

blocks.zh: 重要提醒
blocks.en: Important reminder

blocks.zh: 在無菌製藥環境中，NON-STERILE 標示的包材組件（如未滅菌的橡膠塞）若意外混入無菌充填線，會造成嚴重的污染風險。倉儲管理必須嚴格區分無菌與非無菌組件的存放區域，這也是 Annex 1 §4.3 材料控制要求的核心之一。
blocks.en: In a sterile pharmaceutical environment, if a packaging component marked NON-STERILE (such as an unsterilized rubber stopper) is accidentally introduced onto the aseptic filling line, it creates a serious contamination risk. Warehouse management must strictly separate the storage areas for sterile and non-sterile components, which is also one of the core points of the Annex 1, 4.3, material control requirements.

blocks.zh: 5.3.3–5.3.5 — 滅菌方法符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.3.3–5.3.5 — Sterilization Method Symbols: Commentary

blocks.zh: 為何需要標示滅菌方法？
blocks.en: Why indicate the sterilization method?

blocks.zh: 不同的滅菌方法對材料有不同影響，也決定了殘留物（residuals）的檢測需求。標籤上標示滅菌方法，讓使用者能夠：
blocks.en: Different sterilization methods affect materials differently and also determine the need for residuals testing. Showing the sterilization method on the label allows the user to:

blocks.zh: 評估化學相容性（尤其是EO殘留）
blocks.en: assess chemical compatibility (especially EO residuals)

blocks.zh: 了解產品可能的材料降解風險
blocks.en: understand the possible risk of material degradation in the product

blocks.zh: 確認是否符合所在國家/地區的法規要求
blocks.en: confirm compliance with the regulatory requirements of the relevant country/region

blocks.zh: 追蹤滅菌批次（連結滅菌記錄）
blocks.en: trace the sterilization batch (linking to the sterilization records)

blocks.zh: 各滅菌方法與 ISO 標準對應
blocks.en: Sterilization methods and the corresponding ISO standards

blocks.zh: EO 環氧乙烷（ISO 11135）：廣泛用於對熱敏感的醫療器械，如軟性包裝、電子元件。EO殘留（EO + ECH + EG）需符合ISO 10993-7限量
blocks.en: EO (ethylene oxide) (ISO 11135): widely used for heat-sensitive medical devices, such as flexible packaging and electronic components. EO residuals (EO + ECH + EG) must meet the limits of ISO 10993-7

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌（ISO 11137）：Gamma 射線（Co-60）或電子束（E-beam），不留化學殘留，但可能影響聚合物機械性質
blocks.en: Radiation sterilization (ISO 11137): gamma rays (Co-60) or electron beam (E-beam); leaves no chemical residue but may affect the mechanical properties of polymers

blocks.zh: 蒸氣/高壓蒸汽滅菌（ISO 17665）：製藥最常用，適合耐熱材料（玻璃、不鏽鋼、特定聚合物）。無菌製劑最終滅菌首選
blocks.en: Steam / autoclave sterilization (ISO 17665): the most commonly used in pharma, suitable for heat-resistant materials (glass, stainless steel, certain polymers). The first choice for terminal sterilization of sterile preparations

blocks.zh: 無菌充填（Aseptic Processing）：非終端滅菌，產品本身不能承受終端滅菌，需要最嚴格的環境控制（A 級潔淨室）
blocks.en: Aseptic processing: not terminal sterilization; used where the product itself cannot withstand terminal sterilization, and it requires the strictest environmental control (grade A cleanroom)

blocks.zh: 與 ISO 11135 和 ISO 11137 的整合使用
blocks.en: Integrated use with ISO 11135 and ISO 11137

blocks.zh: ISO 11135（EO滅菌）：規定EO滅菌過程的開發、驗證和常規控制。標籤上的「STERILE EO」聲明需有符合ISO 11135的驗證方案（包含D值測定、最大殘留量驗證）作為支撐文件。
blocks.en: ISO 11135 (EO sterilization): specifies the development, validation and routine control of the EO sterilization process. A "STERILE EO" claim on the label must be supported by a validation programme conforming to ISO 11135 (including D-value determination and verification of maximum residual levels).

blocks.zh: ISO 11137系列（輻射滅菌）：ISO 11137-1 規定要求，ISO 11137-2 提供劑量建立方法，ISO 11137-3 為劑量測量指南。「STERILE R」標籤需有對應的劑量設定確認（VDmax法或SAL法）記錄。
blocks.en: ISO 11137 series (radiation sterilization): ISO 11137-1 specifies the requirements, ISO 11137-2 provides methods for establishing the dose, and ISO 11137-3 gives guidance on dosimetry. A "STERILE R" label requires records of the corresponding dose setting confirmation (VDmax method or SAL method).

blocks.zh: 無菌充填（Aseptic Fill-Finish）特殊說明
blocks.en: Special note on aseptic fill-finish

blocks.zh: 以無菌充填方式生產的藥品，標籤通常只標示「STERILE」而無方法後綴，因為無菌充填不屬於終端滅菌（terminal sterilization）。Annex 1（2022）第8章對無菌充填有詳細要求，包括製程模擬（APS/Media Fill）及環境監控，以確保STERILE聲明的有效性。
blocks.en: For drug products manufactured by aseptic fill-finish, the label usually shows only "STERILE" with no method suffix, because aseptic filling is not terminal sterilization. Annex 1 (2022), Chapter 8, sets detailed requirements for aseptic filling, including process simulation (APS/media fill) and environmental monitoring, to ensure the validity of the STERILE claim.

blocks.zh: 5.3.6–5.3.7 — 禁止再滅菌與單次使用 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.3.6–5.3.7 — Do Not Resterilize and Single Use: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念區分
blocks.en: Distinguishing the core concepts

blocks.zh: 這兩個符號常被混用，但有明確差異：
blocks.en: These two symbols are often confused, but there is a clear difference:

blocks.zh: Do Not Resterilize（§5.3.6）：禁止對此器械再次滅菌。重點在滅菌行為本身，即使用後不可送回高壓鍋或EO腔體再處理
blocks.en: Do Not Resterilize (5.3.6): prohibits sterilizing again this device. The focus is on the act of sterilization itself; after use, the device must not be sent back to the autoclave or EO chamber for reprocessing

blocks.zh: Single Use Only（§5.3.7）：禁止對此器械重複使用，無論是否再滅菌。一次性使用後即廢棄
blocks.en: Single Use Only (5.3.7): prohibits reusing this device, whether or not it is resterilized. It is discarded after a single use

blocks.zh: 製藥包材中的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical applications in pharmaceutical packaging

blocks.zh: 預充式注射器（PFS）：典型的 Single Use Only 器械。充填藥液後，患者或醫護人員使用一次即棄
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes (PFS): a typical Single Use Only device. After it is filled with the drug solution, the patient or healthcare professional uses it once and discards it

blocks.zh: 自動注射筆（Auto-injector）：多為 Single Use；部分多劑型筆為多次使用但每次使用一個針頭
blocks.en: Auto-injectors: mostly single use; some multi-dose pens are reused, but with a fresh needle each time

blocks.zh: 無菌充填用的一次性管路：如蠕動泵管路、灌裝針等，必須標示 Single Use Only；再使用存在微粒污染及生物負載風險
blocks.en: Single-use tubing for aseptic filling: such as peristaltic pump tubing and filling needles, must be marked Single Use Only; reuse poses particulate contamination and bioburden risks

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞（Rubber Stopper）：一次性使用；即使在再蓋塞過程中脫落，也應廢棄而非重新滅菌使用
blocks.en: Rubber stoppers: single use; even if one comes off during the restoppering process, it should be discarded rather than resterilized and reused

blocks.zh: EU MDR 與 FDA SUD 重加工要求
blocks.en: EU MDR and FDA SUD reprocessing requirements

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 Article 17：成員國可允許第三方機構對原本標示 Single Use 的器械進行重加工（reprocessing），但需滿足嚴格的等效安全性要求，且重加工機構需承擔製造商同等責任。
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745 Article 17: Member States may allow third parties to reprocess devices originally marked Single Use, but strict equivalent-safety requirements must be met, and the reprocessor must bear the same responsibilities as the manufacturer.

blocks.zh: FDA SUD Reprocessing：FDA允許對部分SUD重加工，但重加工方需向FDA提交510(k)或PMA申請，提供與原始器械等效的安全性和有效性數據。
blocks.en: FDA SUD reprocessing: FDA permits reprocessing of some single-use devices (SUDs), but the reprocessor must submit a 510(k) or PMA to FDA, providing safety and effectiveness data equivalent to those of the original device.

blocks.zh: 對CDMO而言，若客戶產品使用的器械被標示 Single Use，需在工藝規程（SOP）中明確禁止任何形式的重用，並建立廢棄記錄。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, if a device used in a client's product is marked Single Use, the process procedure (SOP) must expressly prohibit any form of reuse, and a disposal record must be established.

blocks.zh: 直觀類比
blocks.en: Intuitive analogy

blocks.zh: Do Not Resterilize：就像一次性手術刀——即使你能把它擦乾淨，製造商也不允許你再高壓滅菌後重用，因為刀刃的鋒利度和材料完整性已無法保證。
blocks.en: Do Not Resterilize: like a disposable scalpel, even if you could clean it, the manufacturer does not allow you to autoclave it and reuse it, because the sharpness of the blade and the integrity of the material can no longer be guaranteed.

blocks.zh: Single Use Only：就像一次性注射針頭——無論怎麼消毒，針頭使用後即廢棄，這是病人安全和防止交叉感染的基本要求。
blocks.en: Single Use Only: like a disposable injection needle, however it is disinfected, the needle is discarded after use; this is a basic requirement for patient safety and prevention of cross-infection.

blocks.zh: Storage and Handling 儲存與搬運
blocks.en: Storage and Handling

blocks.zh: 5.4.1 — 溫度限制符號 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.4.1 — Temperature Limit Symbol: Commentary

blocks.zh: 溫度限制符號（溫度計加箭頭）是冷鏈管理的視覺核心，直接關係到產品的穩定性和安全性。此符號在生物藥、疫苗及溫度敏感醫療器械的包裝上不可或缺。
blocks.en: The temperature limit symbol (a thermometer with arrows) is the visual core of cold chain management and bears directly on product stability and safety. It is indispensable on the packaging of biologics, vaccines and temperature-sensitive medical devices.

blocks.zh: 冷藏生物製劑（2–8°C）：胰島素、單株抗體、重組蛋白等。標籤上的溫度符號必須與ICH Q1A穩定性研究所核准的溫度條件一致
blocks.en: Refrigerated biologics (2–8°C): insulin, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins and the like. The temperature symbol on the label must match the temperature conditions approved on the basis of the ICH Q1A stability studies

blocks.zh: 冷凍製劑（≤ -20°C 或 ≤ -70°C）：mRNA疫苗（如COVID-19疫苗）需要 -70°C 超低溫冷鏈，此條件需在標籤上明確標示
blocks.en: Frozen products (≤ -20°C or ≤ -70°C): mRNA vaccines (such as COVID-19 vaccines) require an ultra-low-temperature cold chain at -70°C, and this condition must be clearly marked on the label

blocks.zh: 室溫藥品（15–25°C）：固體口服製劑通常標示此範圍；若稍高（可至30°C）則需明確標示「不超過30°C」
blocks.en: Room-temperature drugs (15–25°C): solid oral dosage forms usually carry this range; if the upper limit is slightly higher (up to 30°C), "do not exceed 30°C" must be stated explicitly

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌後組件：某些預滅菌橡膠塞需要特定溫度保存（如避免高溫造成塞子變形影響密封性）
blocks.en: Components after terminal sterilization: some pre-sterilized rubber stoppers need to be stored at a specific temperature (for example, to avoid high temperatures deforming the stopper and affecting seal integrity)

blocks.zh: ICH Q1A 與 WHO 穩定性條件對應
blocks.en: ICH Q1A and WHO stability conditions compared

blocks.zh: 長期條件（Zone I/II）：25°C ± 2°C / 60% RH ± 5% — 對應標籤 15–25°C
blocks.en: Long-term conditions (Zone I/II): 25°C ± 2°C / 60% RH ± 5% — corresponds to a label of 15–25°C

blocks.zh: 長期條件（Zone III/IV）：30°C ± 2°C / 65% RH ± 5%（熱帶地區市場）
blocks.en: Long-term conditions (Zone III/IV): 30°C ± 2°C / 65% RH ± 5% (tropical markets)

blocks.zh: 加速條件：40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH — 用於穩定性預測，非標籤溫度
blocks.en: Accelerated conditions: 40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH — used for stability prediction, not as a label temperature

blocks.zh: 冷藏條件：5°C ± 3°C — 標籤顯示 2–8°C
blocks.en: Refrigerated conditions: 5°C ± 3°C — the label shows 2–8°C

blocks.zh: 冷鏈偏差（Cold Chain Excursion）處理
blocks.en: Handling cold chain excursions

blocks.zh: 當產品在運輸或倉儲中偏離標籤溫度時，需啟動溫度偏差評估程序（Temperature Excursion Assessment）。評估依據包括：累積偏差時間（Mean Kinetic Temperature, MKT）、穩定性數據中的加速老化研究、以及原料藥/製劑的降解動力學模型。ISO 15223-1的溫度符號是此評估流程的起點，也是客訴和法規溝通時的關鍵標籤證據。
blocks.en: When a product deviates from the labelled temperature during transport or storage, a temperature excursion assessment procedure must be initiated. The assessment is based on the cumulative excursion time (mean kinetic temperature, MKT), accelerated ageing studies in the stability data, and degradation kinetics models of the drug substance/drug product. The temperature symbol of ISO 15223-1 is the starting point of this assessment process and is also key label evidence in complaints and regulatory communication.

blocks.zh: 5.4.2–5.4.3 — 濕度限制與防潮 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.4.2–5.4.3 — Humidity Limitation and Keep Dry: Commentary

blocks.zh: 濕度限制（Humidity Limitation）以具體百分比RH表達儲存條件要求；保持乾燥（Keep Dry / 雨傘符號）則是一般性防潮指示，不指定RH值。
blocks.en: Humidity limitation (Humidity Limitation) expresses the storage requirement as a specific percentage RH, whereas Keep Dry (the umbrella symbol) is a general moisture-protection instruction that does not specify an RH value.

blocks.zh: 製藥包材應用
blocks.en: Applications in pharmaceutical packaging

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑密封包裝（Desiccant-sealed）：含乾燥劑的鋁箔袋，適用 Keep Dry 符號，用於吸濕性強的固體藥品或診斷試紙
blocks.en: Desiccant-sealed packaging: foil pouches containing desiccant, to which the Keep Dry symbol applies, used for highly hygroscopic solid drugs or diagnostic test strips

blocks.zh: 凍乾製劑（Lyophilized Products）：瓶塞密封後仍需保持低濕度環境儲存，標籤應標示具體RH上限（如 ≤60% RH）
blocks.en: Lyophilized products: after the vial is stoppered and sealed, a low-humidity storage environment is still needed, and the label should state a specific upper RH limit (such as ≤60% RH)

blocks.zh: 電子元件類醫療器械：如血糖監測儀、心律調節器外部組件，對濕度極敏感，需指定RH範圍
blocks.en: Medical devices with electronic components: such as blood glucose monitors and external components of cardiac pacemakers, are highly sensitive to humidity and need a specified RH range

blocks.zh: TYVEK® 無菌包裝袋：雖有一定防水性，但極端高濕環境仍可能影響密封完整性，需標示濕度限制
blocks.en: TYVEK® sterile packaging pouches: although they have some water resistance, extremely humid environments may still affect seal integrity, so a humidity limit must be marked

blocks.zh: 類比說明
blocks.en: Analogies

blocks.zh: 濕度限制（§5.4.2）：就像食品包裝上「儲存於相對濕度45–75%環境中」的具體要求，讓倉庫管理人員有明確的監控目標。
blocks.en: Humidity limitation (5.4.2): like the specific requirement "store at 45–75% relative humidity" on food packaging, it gives warehouse staff a clear monitoring target.

blocks.zh: 保持乾燥（§5.4.3）：就像「請保持乾燥，切勿淋雨」的通俗指示，適合不需精確RH數值的場合，如防止液態水直接接觸。
blocks.en: Keep dry (5.4.3): like the everyday instruction "keep dry, do not expose to rain", suitable where a precise RH value is not needed, such as preventing direct contact with liquid water.

blocks.zh: 5.4.4–5.4.5 — 易碎品與避光 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.4.4–5.4.5 — Fragile and Keep Away from Sunlight: Commentary
Fragile symbol (5.4.4)

blocks.zh: 破碎玻璃杯符號是國際運輸包裝（ISO 780）中通用的易碎標識，已被ISO 15223-1納入醫療器械標籤體系。代表產品在搬運、運輸、堆疊時需要特別謹慎。
blocks.en: The broken glass symbol is the fragile marking commonly used in international transport packaging (ISO 780) and has been adopted into the medical device labelling system by ISO 15223-1. It indicates that the product needs special care during handling, transport and stacking.

blocks.zh: 製藥包材應用場景
blocks.en: Application scenarios in pharmaceutical packaging

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶/安瓿包裝：Type I 硼矽酸鹽玻璃容器雖然品質優異，但仍是易碎品。運輸外箱應標示易碎符號，內部需有適當緩衝保護
blocks.en: Glass vial/ampoule packaging: although Type I borosilicate glass containers are of excellent quality, they are still fragile. The outer shipping carton should carry the fragile symbol, with appropriate cushioning protection inside

blocks.zh: 光敏感藥品（§5.4.5）：如硝苯地平（光降解成紅色雜質）、維生素 B₂、某些單株抗體。需使用琥珀色（amber）玻璃瓶或鋁箔外包裝
blocks.en: Light-sensitive drugs (5.4.5): such as nifedipine (photodegrading to a red impurity), vitamin B₂ and some monoclonal antibodies. Amber glass vials or foil overwrap are needed

blocks.zh: 診斷試紙/試劑：光可能使試劑變性，降低檢測敏感性；包裝需遮光，標籤需有避光符號
blocks.en: Diagnostic test strips/reagents: light can denature the reagent and reduce detection sensitivity; the packaging must block light and the label needs the keep-away-from-light symbol

blocks.zh: 植入性器械的光活化表面改質：某些表面塗層在紫外光下會降解，需避光保存至使用前
blocks.en: Light-activated surface modification of implantable devices: some surface coatings degrade under ultraviolet light and must be stored protected from light until use

blocks.zh: ICH Q1B 光穩定性要求
blocks.en: ICH Q1B photostability requirements

blocks.zh: ICH Q1B 要求藥品進行光穩定性測試，暴露量為 1.2 × 10⁶ lux·hr（可見光）及 200 W·hr/m²（UV）
blocks.en: ICH Q1B requires photostability testing of drug products, with an exposure of 1.2 × 10⁶ lux·hr (visible light) and 200 W·hr/m² (UV)

blocks.zh: 若原料藥或製劑對光敏感，需在標籤上標示避光符號
blocks.en: If the drug substance or drug product is light-sensitive, a keep-away-from-light symbol must be shown on the label

blocks.zh: 包裝選擇（透明 vs. 琥珀色玻璃）需有光穩定性數據支撐
blocks.en: The choice of packaging (clear vs. amber glass) must be supported by photostability data

blocks.zh: 二次包裝（carton/outer box）對避光符號的貢獻需在穩定性研究中驗證
blocks.en: The contribution of secondary packaging (carton/outer box) to the light-protection symbol must be verified in the stability studies

blocks.zh: 避光包裝類比
blocks.en: Analogy for light-protective packaging

blocks.zh: 就像珍貴的紅酒需要存放在酒窖而非向陽的窗台——光線對分子結構的影響是緩慢但不可逆的。對光敏感藥品，一次倉庫日光燈照射時間過長，可能在不知不覺中讓整批藥品的效價降低。
blocks.en: Just as fine red wine needs to be kept in a cellar rather than on a sunny windowsill, the effect of light on molecular structure is slow but irreversible. For a light-sensitive drug, one overly long exposure to warehouse fluorescent lighting may unknowingly reduce the potency of a whole batch.

blocks.zh: 5.4.6 — 包裝損壞禁止使用 中文說明
blocks.en: 5.4.6 — Do Not Use If Package Is Damaged: Commentary

blocks.zh: 「包裝損壞禁止使用」符號是無菌屏障系統（Sterile Barrier System, SBS）完整性的用戶界面。此符號提醒使用者：若包裝完整性已受損，廠商對產品的無菌性保證即告失效。
blocks.en: The "Do not use if package is damaged" symbol is the user-facing expression of the integrity of the sterile barrier system (SBS). It reminds the user that if package integrity has been compromised, the manufacturer's sterility assurance for the product is void.

blocks.zh: 預充式注射器（PFS）的 Nest+Tub 系統：外層 TYVEK® 袋若有針孔或密封不完整，整個 Nest 的無菌性均無法保證，需廢棄
blocks.en: Nest + tub systems for prefilled syringes (PFS): if the outer TYVEK® pouch has a pinhole or an incomplete seal, the sterility of the whole nest cannot be guaranteed and it must be discarded

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶充填後的目視檢查：壓蓋完整性（crimp integrity）檢查中發現異常，即使產品本身未暴露，仍需依照 SOP 處理
blocks.en: Visual inspection after vial filling: if an abnormality is found in the crimp integrity check, it must be handled according to the SOP even if the product itself was not exposed

blocks.zh: 終端使用者檢查：醫院藥劑師或護理人員在使用前必須目視檢查包裝完整性，此符號正是提醒他們執行這個步驟
blocks.en: End-user inspection: hospital pharmacists or nurses must visually check package integrity before use, and this symbol is exactly the reminder to carry out that step

blocks.zh: 冷鏈運輸後驗收：收貨時需同時檢查溫度記錄（溫度符號）和包裝完整性（本符號）
blocks.en: Acceptance after cold chain transport: on receipt, both the temperature record (temperature symbol) and package integrity (this symbol) must be checked

blocks.zh: ISO 11607 無菌屏障系統要求
blocks.en: ISO 11607 sterile barrier system requirements

blocks.zh: ISO 11607-1：規定滅菌醫療器械包裝的材料、密封系統及屏障設計要求
blocks.en: ISO 11607-1: specifies requirements for materials, sealing systems and barrier design for the packaging of sterilized medical devices

blocks.zh: ISO 11607-2：規定成型、密封和組裝過程的驗證要求
blocks.en: ISO 11607-2: specifies validation requirements for the forming, sealing and assembly processes

blocks.zh: 密封強度測試：剝離強度（peel strength）測試確保密封不會在正常使用條件下意外開啟
blocks.en: Seal strength testing: peel strength testing ensures that the seal will not open unexpectedly under normal conditions of use

blocks.zh: 染料滲透測試（Dye Penetration Test）：ISO 11607常用完整性測試方法，驗證密封無微泄漏
blocks.en: Dye penetration test: a commonly used ISO 11607 integrity test method, verifying that the seal has no micro-leaks

blocks.zh: Annex 1 連結（第8章：包裝完整性）
blocks.en: Link to Annex 1 (Chapter 8: package integrity)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022）第8.116條要求：「最終容器的密封性應通過驗證的方法定期檢查（容器密封完整性測試，CCIT）。」此符號在用戶端提供了對應的視覺提示，是從生產品質控制到終端使用者行為控制的完整鏈條中的最後一環。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), 8.116, requires: "Container closure integrity should be checked at regular intervals using validated methods (container closure integrity testing, CCIT)." This symbol provides the corresponding visual cue at the user end and is the last link in the complete chain from production quality control to end-user behaviour control.

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法包括：氦氣質譜法（Helium Mass Spectrometry）、電容法（HVL/Electrical Capacitance）、激光氣體偵測法（Laser-based Headspace Analysis）等，均用於驗證上述無菌屏障聲明的有效性。
blocks.en: CCIT methods include helium mass spectrometry, electrical capacitance (HVLD, high voltage leak detection) and laser-based headspace analysis, all used to verify the validity of the sterile barrier claim above.

blocks.zh: Cross-References & Related Standards 跨標準連結
blocks.en: Cross-References & Related Standards

blocks.zh: 跨標準整合說明
blocks.en: Notes on cross-standard integration

blocks.zh: 為何理解跨標準連結如此重要？
blocks.en: Why is it so important to understand cross-standard links?

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 的符號是「聲明」，而相關標準（ISO 11135、ISO 11137、ISO 17665 等）是「聲明的依據」。在法規審查（如FDA 510(k)、CE Marking Technical Documentation、PDMA審查）中，審查員不只看標籤上有無符號，還要確認符號背後有完整的符合性文件（Compliance Documentation）。
blocks.en: The symbols of ISO 15223-1 are "claims", and the related standards (ISO 11135, ISO 11137, ISO 17665 and so on) are the "basis for the claims". In regulatory review (such as FDA 510(k), CE marking technical documentation, or PDMA review), reviewers look not only at whether a symbol is on the label but also at whether complete compliance documentation stands behind the symbol.

blocks.zh: CDMO 符合性文件清單（以 STERILE EO 為例）
blocks.en: CDMO compliance documentation checklist (taking STERILE EO as an example)

blocks.zh: ISO 11135 滅菌驗證報告（包含生物負荷測試、最大滅菌劑量確認）
blocks.en: ISO 11135 sterilization validation report (including bioburden testing and confirmation of the maximum sterilization dose)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-7 EO 殘留量測試報告（EO、ECH、EG 三種殘留物）
blocks.en: ISO 10993-7 EO residuals test report (the three residuals EO, ECH and EG)

blocks.zh: ISO 11607-1/-2 包裝系統驗證報告（密封強度、老化測試）
blocks.en: ISO 11607-1/-2 packaging system validation report (seal strength, ageing tests)

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究報告（支撐有效期限聲明）
blocks.en: Stability study report (supporting the expiry date claim)

blocks.zh: 標籤設計審核記錄（ISO 15223-1 符號正確性確認）
blocks.en: Label design review record (confirmation that the ISO 15223-1 symbols are correct)

blocks.zh: TFDA（台灣食藥署）應用說明
blocks.en: TFDA (Taiwan Food and Drug Administration) application notes

blocks.zh: 台灣依據「醫療器材管理法」及衛生福利部公告的「醫療器材標示規定」，要求輸入/國產醫療器材標籤符合 ISO 15223-1 的符號規定，或以等效方式（文字）表達相同資訊。TFDA 審查人員熟悉 ISO 15223-1 符號，使用此國際標準可簡化審查溝通並加速核准流程。
blocks.en: Under Taiwan's Medical Devices Act and the Ministry of Health and Welfare's published medical device labelling rules, the labels of imported and domestic medical devices must comply with the symbol provisions of ISO 15223-1 or express the same information by an equivalent means (text). TFDA reviewers are familiar with the ISO 15223-1 symbols, and using this international standard can simplify review communication and speed up the approval process.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions 練習問題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 參考解析 Reference Answers
blocks.en: Reference Answers

blocks.zh: 問題1 解析
blocks.en: Question 1: Answer

blocks.zh: 沙漏符號 = 有效期限（Use By Date），依據 ISO 15223-1 § 5.2.1。2028-03 代表有效期至 2028年3月。
blocks.en: The hourglass symbol = use-by date (Use By Date), per ISO 15223-1, 5.2.1. 2028-03 means the product expires in March 2028.

blocks.zh: 製造日期 2026-03 + 24個月 = 2028-03，有效期限正確。
blocks.en: Date of manufacture 2026-03 + 24 months = 2028-03, so the expiry date is correct.

blocks.zh: 無方法後綴的「STERILE」表示無菌充填（Aseptic Fill-Finish），即非終端滅菌；產品在無菌條件下充填，本身未經獨立的終端滅菌步驟。
blocks.en: "STERILE" without a method suffix indicates aseptic fill-finish, that is, not terminal sterilization; the product is filled under aseptic conditions and has not undergone a separate terminal sterilization step.

blocks.zh: 溫度符號 2–8°C 代表冷藏儲存要求；ICH Q1A 的長期穩定性條件（Zone）及 WHO TRS 961 冷鏈 GDP 指引均相關。
blocks.en: The temperature symbol 2–8°C indicates a refrigerated storage requirement; the ICH Q1A long-term stability conditions (zones) and the WHO TRS 961 cold chain GDP guidance are both relevant.

blocks.zh: 問題2 解析
blocks.en: Question 2: Answer

blocks.zh: 對熱敏感（不可高壓蒸氣）且不可輻射的聚合物，環氧乙烷（EO）滅菌（§5.3.3）是最適選項。
blocks.en: For a polymer that is heat-sensitive (cannot be steam autoclaved) and cannot be irradiated, ethylene oxide (EO) sterilization (5.3.3) is the most suitable option.

blocks.zh: 標籤應顯示 STERILE EO（或 STERILE EOG）。
blocks.en: The label should show STERILE EO (or STERILE EOG).

blocks.zh: EO滅菌驗證依據 ISO 11135。
blocks.en: EO sterilization validation follows ISO 11135.

blocks.zh: EO殘留測試（EO、ECH乙二醇、EG乙二醇）依據 ISO 10993-7，需符合限量要求。
blocks.en: EO residuals testing (EO, ECH (ethylene chlorohydrin) and EG (ethylene glycol)) follows ISO 10993-7 and must meet the limit requirements.

blocks.zh: 問題3 解析
blocks.en: Question 3: Answer

blocks.zh: 標籤缺少溫度限制符號（§5.4.1），應標示「-70°C ± 10°C」或等效表示。
blocks.en: The label lacks the temperature limit symbol (5.4.1); it should state "-70°C ± 10°C" or an equivalent expression.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 §8.120 要求標籤包含儲存條件資訊；缺少溫度標示是標籤缺陷（labeling deficiency），構成潛在的法規違規。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1, 8.120, requires the label to include storage condition information; a missing temperature marking is a labelling deficiency and constitutes a potential regulatory violation.

blocks.zh: 啟動溫度偏差評估（Temperature Excursion Assessment）：記錄偏差詳情、計算MKT（平均動力溫度）、諮詢穩定性數據，決定是否放行、使用或廢棄。
blocks.en: Initiate a temperature excursion assessment: record the details of the excursion, calculate the MKT (mean kinetic temperature), consult the stability data, and decide whether to release, use or discard.

blocks.zh: 問題4 解析
blocks.en: Question 4: Answer

blocks.zh: 標籤不完整。缺少針頭的Single Use Only 符號（§5.3.7）；針持為多次使用器械，不需 Single Use 符號，但需在標籤或 IFU 中明確說明可重複使用次數及再滅菌要求。
blocks.en: The label is incomplete. The needle is missing the Single Use Only symbol (5.3.7); the needle holder is a reusable device and does not need the Single Use symbol, but the label or IFU must clearly state the number of permitted reuses and the resterilization requirements.

blocks.zh: Do Not Resterilize（§5.3.6）禁止「再滅菌行為」；Single Use Only（§5.3.7）禁止「再次使用於任何患者」。兩者常同時適用於一次性器械，但涵蓋不同層面的使用行為。
blocks.en: Do Not Resterilize (5.3.6) prohibits the act of resterilizing; Single Use Only (5.3.7) prohibits using the device again on any patient. The two often apply together to a single-use device, but they cover different aspects of use.

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 Article 17 要求製造商在 Single Use 器械的標籤上清楚標示該符號；若有第三方再加工，再加工方需承擔原製造商等同的責任並向主管機關通報。
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745 Article 17 requires the manufacturer to show this symbol clearly on the label of a Single Use device; if a third party reprocesses it, the reprocessor must bear responsibilities equivalent to those of the original manufacturer and notify the competent authority.

blocks.zh: 問題5 解析
blocks.en: Question 5: Answer

blocks.zh: 應立即隔離並廢棄3支受損包裝的藥瓶，依據 ISO 15223-1 § 5.4.6（包裝損壞禁止使用符號）。密封失效意味著無菌屏障已受損，即使產品外觀正常也不能使用。
blocks.en: The 3 vials with damaged packaging should be quarantined and discarded immediately, in accordance with ISO 15223-1, 5.4.6 (the do-not-use-if-package-is-damaged symbol). Seal failure means the sterile barrier has been compromised, and the product cannot be used even if it looks normal.

blocks.zh: 應建立偏差報告（Deviation Report）記錄：發現時間、批次號、受影響數量、隔離措施，並向藥品供應商發送品質通知（Quality Notification / Non-conformance Report）。
blocks.en: A deviation report should be raised recording the time of discovery, batch number, quantity affected and quarantine measures, and a quality notification (Quality Notification / Non-conformance Report) should be sent to the drug supplier.

blocks.zh: 密封完整性要求由 ISO 11607-1（設計要求）和 ISO 11607-2（過程驗證）規範；TYVEK® 密封強度（Peel Strength）不達標即違反 ISO 11607-1 要求。
blocks.en: Seal integrity requirements are governed by ISO 11607-1 (design requirements) and ISO 11607-2 (process validation); TYVEK® seal strength (peel strength) falling short of the requirement violates ISO 11607-1.

blocks.zh: 3% 密封失敗率表明密封過程（Sealing Process）可能超出驗證範圍；製造商需啟動CAPA，重新確認密封參數（溫度、壓力、時間）是否在驗證邊界內，並評估是否需要擴大調查範圍（同生產批次其他產品）。
blocks.en: A 3% seal failure rate indicates that the sealing process may be outside its validated range; the manufacturer must initiate a CAPA, reconfirm whether the sealing parameters (temperature, pressure, time) are within the validated boundaries, and assess whether the investigation needs to be widened (to other products from the same production batch).
